rdfs:label: sharedInbox
rdfs:comment: An ActivityPub server endpoint, advertised in an actor's `endpoints`, that accepts deliveries for any local recipient — used to deduplicate fan-out when one Activity targets many followers on the same server.
notes: Lives inside the `as:endpoints` object of an actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service). Federation pattern: when delivering an Activity addressed to many followers, a sender SHOULD POST once to each receiving server's `sharedInbox` rather than once per follower's per-actor `inbox` — reducing delivery from one POST per recipient to one POST per receiving server. ActivityPub also allows delivering public Activities to known sharedInboxes for wider distribution.

history.note: Notes: fixed 'quadratic' claim (per-recipient -> per-server POSTs), added public-delivery use; dropped non-existent Actor class seeAlso.
